Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.27.3:

- Server Infrastructure (Step 5) scope mapping refined: FSM Server and SQL Server are now only shown for Web / Email / DLP (they are no longer asked for DSPM, FDC or NGFW). DLP shows FSM, SQL, Protector, Supplemental and Content Gateway; Email shows FSM, SQL and Email Gateway; Web shows FSM, SQL and Content Gateway; DSPM shows the DSPM Server; Classification shows the Classification Server (FDC).
- Any server type remains addable via 'Add Additional Server Instance'.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
